title: Bug 650391: [Subcontracting] Show subcontracting transfer quantities
summary: The Prod. Order Comp. Line List page extension now displays transfer quantity fields (Qty. on Transfer Order, Qty. transf. to Subcontractor, and Qty. in Transit) for subcontracting components.
key_points: Prod. Order Comp. Line List extension now shows existing subcontracting transfer FlowFields
Qty. on Transfer Order (Base) and Qty. transf. to Subcontractor are visible by default
Qty. in Transit (Base) is added as a hidden-by-default personalization control
Fixes the fields missing from the Production Components FactBox drill-down
quote: Add Qty. on Transfer Order (Base) and Qty. transf. to Subcontractor as visible controls.
